defects.summary: Search lowercases the term but not the item name, so it is only case-insensitive when the stored name is already lowercase ('bolt' does not find 'Hex Bolt').
Help for --min-qty says 'more than N' but the code (and the task) keep items with a quantity of at least N.

decoys.summary: Exiting with status 1 and printing nothing when no item matches looks like an error path but is exactly what the task asks for.
--max-price is kept as text and parsed into a Decimal, then compared with '>' so a price equal to the limit is kept; this is correct (no float rounding, 'at most P').
